title: The Case of the Rich Woman — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
Meaning is not found in The Case of the Rich Woman — it is manufactured for it. Parker Pyne Investigates is a short story collection written by Agatha Christie and first published in the UK by William Collins and Sons in November 1934. Along with The Listerdale Mystery, this collection did not appear under the usual imprint of the Collins Crime Club but instead appeared as part of the Collins Mystery series.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — The Case of the Rich Woman shows exactly where that breaks. Schlagal confides that he suspects Lady Esther of murdering her companion, claiming he saw signs of madness in her behavior. Pyne, aware of the Carr family’s history of mental illness, takes interest in the case.
